narrative_purpose: The full-bleed atmospheric mood layer the chapter's text floats over: a vast, dim, planet-scale view of Pandora's forest network at night, a faint web of bioluminescent connection stretching unbroken to the horizon — the living network at rest, immense and quietly resilient.
subject: An ultra-wide, very high-altitude panorama of a continent-spanning Pandoran forest at deep night, seen from far above. Across the whole dark landscape runs a barely-visible, gossamer-fine web of cyan bioluminescent connections linking countless points of faint light into one continuous network that fades into atmospheric haze at the horizon. No single bright subject — just the immense, dim, connected whole, with one faint scar of darker burned ground that the surrounding web simply routes around and closes over.
scene: A planet-scale forest network at night from very high vantage, dissolving into haze; a faint unbroken web of connection over a vast dark land.
camera: Ultra-wide panoramic, very high aerial vantage, deep atmospheric perspective.
light: Extremely low-key: faint bioluminescent web glow against deep void-indigo dark; no bright focal light; detail dissolving into haze.
palette: Dominant void-indigo and deep teal-indigo dark; sparse faint Pandora cyan in the distant web; very low contrast for overlaid text readability.
style: Painterly speculative-biology naturalist plate, dim and atmospheric, hand-painted texture.
detail_level: Low and soft throughout — a mood layer, not a figure to study; everything dissolving into haze.
composition: Vast horizontal expanse, horizon high, the faint network filling the dark field; deliberately empty and dim so long-form text floats readably over it.
consistency_notes: This is the wide dim background layer, distinct from the crisp fig-00 cover. Keep it dark, low-contrast, and subjectless so overlaid text stays legible. Cool palette only.
negative_prompt: no text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no diagram labels, no arrows, no bright focal subject, no high contrast, no photographic or 3D-render look, no lens flares, no neon UI glow, no cartoon or anime style
